events.title: Morgan Stanley sees Thai refiners boosting dividends sharply
events.summary: Morgan Stanley predicts a significant increase in dividends from Thai refiners, expecting them to rise three times in 2026. This is attributed to companies distributing excess profits after reducing debt and a positive outlook on the durability of the refining cycle. The bank anticipates stronger cash generation due to sustained high annual refining margins and improving balance sheets.

articles.headline: Morgan Stanley sees Thai refiners boosting dividends sharply

events.title: Duke Energy stock holds steady as nuclear and data-center plans shape outlook
events.summary: Duke Energy's stock is trading just above $50 as the company advances plans for new nuclear generation in the Carolinas and prepares to meet growing data-center demand in Florida under a new state law. While addressing these strategic initiatives, the utility also faces regulatory scrutiny over solar procurement in North Carolina and political pressure regarding rate increases in Ohio. Investors are evaluating how Duke Energy will navigate these complex regulatory and capital expenditure challenges to ensure stable earnings and dividend support.

articles.headline: Duke Energy stock holds steady as nuclear and data-center plans shape outlook

events.title: Exxon Mobil stock holds in the low $160s as Guyana output and dividend strength shape the outlook
events.summary: Exxon Mobil stock is trading in the low $160s, supported by strong Q2 2026 earnings of $14.5 billion and operating cash flow of $23.6 billion. The company's investment appeal is strengthened by its growing free cash flow from Guyana, which reached 900,000 barrels per day in Q2 2026 and has recovered $55 billion in investment, alongside a 43-year track record of dividend increases. Despite recent oil price volatility, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with an average target price of $166.10, recognizing the stock's year-to-date gain of 36.15%.

articles.headline: Exxon Mobil stock holds in the low $160s as Guyana output and dividend strength shape the outlook

events.title: Should Sonoco’s EMEA Paperboard Price Hike to Counter Inflation Require Action From Sonoco (SON) Investors?
events.summary: Sonoco Products Company has raised prices by €60 per ton on uncoated recycled paperboard in the EMEA region starting September 15, 2026, to combat inflationary pressures. This strategic move aims to offset higher input costs, impacting customer relationships and margin resilience in a key European market. Investors will be monitoring how this price hike affects Sonoco's margins and sales volumes, especially given existing concerns about softer European demand and integration efforts.

articles.headline: Should Sonoco’s EMEA Paperboard Price Hike to Counter Inflation Require Action From Sonoco (SON) Investors?

events.title: Occidental Petroleum stock holds above $58 as sanctions and Hormuz talks shape oil outlook
events.summary: Occidental Petroleum (OXY) stock is trading in the high-$50s, influenced by volatile oil markets due to new Iran sanctions and talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. While crude prices softened on Hormuz optimism, sanctions on Iranian exports could tighten global supply. Analysts maintain mid-$60s price targets, suggesting potential upside despite the recent pullback, and institutional investors continue to show confidence in the company.

articles.headline: Occidental Petroleum stock holds above $58 as sanctions and Hormuz talks shape oil outlook

events.title: Fort Technology acquires 50.1% stake in Logia USA
events.summary: Fort Technology Inc., a majority-owned subsidiary of Nexera Technologies Ltd., has acquired a 50.1% stake in Logia USA Inc. for approximately $125,000 in newly-issued common shares. The acquisition aims to expand Logia Israel Ltd's fuel integrity solutions for data centers into the U.S. market, supported by a $2.0 million credit facility. This strategic move aligns with Fort Technology's broader plans to expand its retail operations, currently focused on pest control and remedial repair products in Europe, into the United States.

articles.headline: Fort Technology acquires 50.1% stake in Logia USA

events.title: Fort Technology Closes Acquisition of Logia USA - Fuel Integrity Solutions for Data Centers Company
events.summary: Fort Technology Inc. has completed its acquisition of 50.1% of Logia USA Inc., a company specializing in fuel integrity solutions for data centers and other critical facilities. This acquisition allows Fort Technology to expand into the US market, leveraging Logia USA's automated systems to ensure reliable backup power in the rapidly growing global data center sector. As part of the agreement, Logia USA's founder, Mr. Yair Harel, will continue as CEO and Fort Technology will provide a $2.0 million credit facility for market entry and growth.

articles.headline: Fort Technology Closes Acquisition of Logia USA - Fuel Integrity Solutions for Data Centers Company
Nexera Technologies Subsidiary Fort Completes Acquisition of Majority Stake in Logia USA to Expand Fuel Integrity Solutions for Data Centers

events.title: Starbucks stock holds above $105 as guidance raised and turnaround gains momentum
events.summary: Starbucks stock is trading above $105, supported by strong fiscal third-quarter results, a raised 2026 earnings guidance, and ongoing "Back to Starbucks" initiatives. The company reported EPS of $0.85 and revenue of $9.32 billion, exceeding analyst estimates, and updated its adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $2.55 to $2.65 for fiscal 2026. Global comparable store sales increased by 7.9%, driven by a 4.2% rise in transaction volume, indicating progress in its turnaround strategy despite some valuation models suggesting the stock is trading slightly above fair value.

articles.headline: Starbucks stock holds above $105 as guidance raised and turnaround gains momentum

events.title: Sempra stock attracts fresh institutional buying as shares trade in the mid-$80s
events.summary: Sempra stock is drawing renewed interest from large institutional investors, trading in the mid-$80s, driven by a significant $65 billion utilities capital plan and an analyst consensus price target of $103.62, implying over 20% upside. The company is also strategically reallocating resources, focusing 95% of its capital plan on regulated North American infrastructure while divesting non-core assets like a natural gas company in Mexico. This strategy, combined with steady institutional buying, suggests confidence in predictable cash flows and earnings growth from its regulated asset base.

articles.headline: Sempra stock attracts fresh institutional buying as shares trade in the mid-$80s

events.title: Keurig Dr Pepper stock holds steady as Q2 2026 earnings beat and 2026 guidance is reaffirmed
events.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) stock held steady in late August 2026 after the company reported Q2 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $0.57, exceeding analyst expectations of $0.54, and reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance for net sales between $25.9 billion and $26.4 billion and low double-digit EPS growth. The company's performance was boosted by growth in soft drinks and energy drinks, which offset weaknesses in its coffee segment, expected to improve in the second half of 2026. KDP also highlighted its commitment to deleveraging, aiming for a management leverage of 4.1 times by year-end 2026, and continuous product innovation with launches like Mott's Zero Sugar.

articles.headline: Keurig Dr Pepper stock holds steady as Q2 2026 earnings beat and 2026 guidance is reaffirmed

events.title: Odyssean LLC Buys New Shares in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD
events.summary: Odyssean LLC has acquired a new stake of 2,775 shares in Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), valued at approximately $1.6 million, during the second quarter. This move comes as institutional investors now hold 71.34% of AMD's stock. Analysts generally maintain a bullish outlook on AMD, with Raymond James upgrading the stock to "Strong Buy" and a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating, supported by AMD's reported 50.1% year-over-year revenue growth.

articles.headline: Odyssean LLC Buys New Shares in Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. $AMD

events.title: Man Group plc Acquires Shares of 1,475,345 Otis Worldwide Corporation $OTIS
events.summary: Man Group plc acquired 1,475,345 shares of Otis Worldwide Corporation ($OTIS) in the second quarter, a new stake valued at approximately $105.6 million. Institutional investors own 88.03% of Otis, with several increasing their positions. Analysts have a mixed sentiment with a "Hold" consensus rating and a target price of $92.91.

articles.headline: Man Group plc Acquires Shares of 1,475,345 Otis Worldwide Corporation $OTIS

events.title: Man Group plc Acquires New Shares in VICI Properties Inc. $VICI
events.summary: Man Group plc has acquired a new stake in VICI Properties Inc. (NYSE:VICI), purchasing over 11.9 million shares valued at approximately $318.2 million. This acquisition makes Man Group plc one of many institutional investors increasing their positions in VICI Properties, which now sees 97.71% of its stock owned by institutional investors. The article also details VICI Properties' recent financial performance, dividend announcements, and current analyst ratings.

articles.headline: Man Group plc Acquires New Shares in VICI Properties Inc. $VICI

events.title: Man Group plc Acquires Shares of 187,497 Cummins Inc. $CMI
events.summary: Man Group plc has acquired a new stake of 187,497 shares in Cummins Inc. (NYSE:CMI), valued at approximately $133.7 million, according to its latest 13F filing. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their holdings in Cummins. The company recently reported its quarterly earnings, missing analyst estimates, but also declared an increased quarterly dividend of $2.20 per share.

articles.headline: Man Group plc Acquires Shares of 187,497 Cummins Inc. $CMI

events.title: Prediction market traders all but rule out an Nvidia earnings miss
events.summary: Prediction market traders on Polymarket are placing a 97% probability on Nvidia beating Wall Street's profit forecasts for its upcoming earnings report. Despite this confidence, Nvidia's stock recently snapped a seven-day losing streak, highlighting investor sensitivity. The market is also keenly focused on the company's guidance for the next quarter, particularly regarding new accelerator platforms and customer purchasing behavior amidst concerns about AI infrastructure returns.

articles.headline: Prediction market traders all but rule out an Nvidia earnings miss

events.title: Community West Bancshares director Lokey acquires $1,405 common stock By Investing.com
events.summary: James W. Lokey, a director at Community West Bancshares (NASDAQ:CWBC), recently acquired 54.23 shares of common stock totaling $1,405 through dividend reinvestment. This transaction increases his direct holdings to 15,228.902 shares. The company's stock has seen a significant increase year-to-date and over the past year, and it is considered slightly undervalued according to InvestingPro analysis, with D.A. Davidson maintaining a Buy rating despite recent merger-related adjustments.

articles.headline: Community West Bancshares director Lokey acquires $1,405 common stock By Investing.com

events.title: Best-Performing Leveraged ETFs of Last Week
events.summary: Last week saw a mixed performance on Wall Street, with initial declines due to AI bubble fears, followed by a strong finish after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell hinted at a potential September rate cut. This news led to a rally in markets, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all experiencing gains. The article highlights several leveraged ETFs that performed well, benefiting from these market movements, including those tied to cryptocurrency, inverse AI stocks, regional banks, and cannabis.

articles.headline: Best-Performing Leveraged ETFs of Last Week

events.title: Honeywell Aerospace faces securities law probe after Q2 earnings miss and stock plunge.
events.summary: Honeywell Aerospace is facing a securities law probe by Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP after reporting a 32% drop in adjusted earnings per share for Q2 2026 and lowering its organic growth forecast, leading to a stock price fall of over 23%. The investigation will focus on potential violations of U.S. securities laws. Investors who incurred losses are encouraged to contact the firm for legal advice.

articles.headline: Honeywell Aerospace faces securities law probe after Q2 earnings miss and stock plunge.

events.title: INTU Stock Is Tumbling Despite Earnings Beat — Weak 2027 Guidance Is Weighing On Intuit Shares
events.summary: Intuit (INTU) shares dropped over 11% despite beating fiscal Q4 earnings and revenue estimates. The decline was primarily due to weaker-than-expected guidance for fiscal 2027 and Q1, with both adjusted EPS and revenue forecasts falling significantly below analyst expectations. Retail traders on Stocktwits were divided, with some viewing the sell-off as a buying opportunity and others seeing it as a sign of deeper issues.

articles.headline: INTU Stock Is Tumbling Despite Earnings Beat — Weak 2027 Guidance Is Weighing On Intuit Shares

events.title: Expion360 changes name, enters oil and gas with Louisiana deal By Investing.com
events.summary: Expion360 Inc. has changed its corporate name to Expion Energy, Inc. and is entering the oil and gas sector with the acquisition of an exploration opportunity in Eastern Louisiana for $3.4 million. Kevin Sellers has been appointed as the new CEO. The company, previously known for lithium iron phosphate batteries, will now commit up to $4 million for a leasing program and is required to drill a new lateral wellbore by February 15, 2027.

articles.headline: Expion360 changes name, enters oil and gas with Louisiana deal By Investing.com
